
# Sitecroft

> Sitecroft provides professional web development services,
> specializing in WordPress development, custom-coded websites,
> React, Next.js, WooCommerce, landing pages, and website support.

Website: https://sitecroftdev.dnnengineer.com/

## About Sitecroft

Sitecroft is a web development service provider helping
businesses, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and organizations
build and improve their online presence.

The focus is on building modern, responsive, performance-oriented
websites with clean code, practical functionality, and
user-friendly designs.

Sitecroft offers both WordPress-based solutions and
custom-coded web development.

## Main Services

### WordPress Website Development

Professional WordPress websites built using customized,
optimized themes and responsive layouts.

https://sitecroftdev.dnnengineer.com/services

### Custom Website Development

Custom-coded websites and web applications developed using:

- React
- Next.js
- Vite
- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- TypeScript

Solutions focus on performance, responsive design,
maintainability, and search engine optimization.

### WooCommerce Development

Online store development using WooCommerce, including
product configuration, payment integration, shopping carts,
checkout, and store management.

### Landing Page Development

Conversion-focused landing pages for products, services,
marketing campaigns, and businesses.

### WordPress Support

WordPress plugin configuration, page creation, blog setup,
design modifications, and general website tasks.

### Website Bug Fixing

Troubleshooting WordPress errors, plugin conflicts,
broken layouts, and website functionality issues.

### Website Maintenance

Ongoing website updates, backups, security checks,
and maintenance.

### Domain and Hosting Setup

Domain configuration, DNS setup, hosting configuration,
SSL installation, WordPress installation, and Vercel deployment.
